def factor_retvol_delay(df):
    """-past_ret_5 * vol_ratio_5_20"""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    past_ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change(5)
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol5 = ret.rolling(5, min_periods=5).std()
    vol20 = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std()
    vol_ratio = vol5 / vol20.replace(0, np.nan)
    vol_ratio = vol_ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    factor = -past_ret * vol_ratio
    factor = factor.fillna(0)
    df_copy["factor_retvol_delay"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_retvol_delay"]
description: When the recent return is extremely negative and 5-day volatility spikes relative to 20-day volatility, it signals an oversold bounce; conversely, after a sharp rally, elevated short-term vol indicates an overbought reversal. The negative sign on past return ensures the factor is positively monotonic with mean-reversion: positive factor indicates higher expected returns (buy) and negative indicates lower expected returns (sell).
